note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations for the twenty-one members were received by Mr. S. Lecky on 28 April 1933; there was no contest: thirteen members were nominated (Belfast Telegraph, 29 April 1933, p. 4) and the outgoing members of the other eight divisions were automatically returned; the Ballymoney Free Press (11 May 1933, p. 1) prints the complete list of twenty-one. Polling in County Londonderry took place on 2 June 1933. Filed on 1933-06-02, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Londonderry that year (confirmed). Completed in the meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026. No nomination was received; the outgoing member was automatically returned (not among the thirteen nominations printed by the Belfast Telegraph, 29 April 1933, p. 4). George Linton died during the term; Mr. John H. M'Cay, J.P., was co-opted for the Garvagh division in July 1933 (a co-option, not an election). Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
